text: This is how much it costs to drive a car or motorcycle in Germany. This is important to know beforebuying a car.

If you drive a car, it must be insured. The cost of insurance depends on the type of car, the value of the car, your driving experience, and many other things. In general, you will pay€100to €1,000per year. There are manyways to pay less for car insurance. Car insurance payments come directly from your bank account. How does German car insurance works How does German car insurance works Car insurance comparator (in German)– Verivox Car insurance comparator (in German)– Verivox Car insurance comparator (in German)– Tarifcheck

You must pay a vehicle tax (Kraftfahrzeugsteuer) every year. For most cars, it costsaround €100per year. For motorcycles, it costs around €50per year. The maximum amount is around €375per year.1The vehicle tax is taken directly from your bank account. Vehicle tax calculator– Ministry of Finance

Fuel prices in Germany are similar to the rest of Europe. They are much higher than in Russia, Central Asia, North America and South America. They are higher than most of Asia. Since Germans have high incomes, fuel is still very affordable. Fuel price database– Clever Tanken Gasoline prices around the world Fuel price database– ADAC

Every 2 years, your car must be inspected at a TÜV or Dekra test centre (Prüfstelle). This is called theHauptuntersuchungorHU. The inspection costsaround €120every 2 years.2If your car does not pass the inspection, you will need to fix the problems before you can drive again.

You must keep your car in good condition. You must repair it when it breaks, but also do regular maintenance like oil changes, tire changes, etc. In Germany, if there is snow or ice on the ground, you must have winter tires.3There are no specific dates for changing to winter tires. It only depends on the road conditions. If you have an accident with summer tires in winter conditions, your insurance might not cover you.3 Cost of ownership calculator– ADAC Cost of ownership calculator– Autokostencheck.de
In Germany, all roads are free for vehicles under 7.5 tons.4There are no tolls for vehicles under 7.5 tons. Information about toll roads in Germany Toll road atlas– Toll Collect

If you live in a big city, you might need to pay for parking. Most central neighbourhoods have parking meters. Parking there can get expensive. In Berlin, you need a permit (Bewohnerparkausweis) to park in your neighbourhood. You canapply for a parking permit online.It costs €20.40, and it’s valid for 2 years.5If you don’t have a parking permit, you must usually pay at the parking meter. Parking is usually free outside theRingbahn. If you haveseasonal plates, you must find a garage or a private parking to store your vehicle. You can’t leave it on the street out of season.
